node.statement: Set epsilon_R:=W.L*epsilon. Since 0 <= L^0*epsilon <= epsilon_R, each upper-error inequality in def-epsilon-cstar-algebra valid with tolerance L^0*epsilon remains valid with epsilon_R, while the lower C*-inequality remains valid because 1-epsilon_R <= 1-L^0*epsilon; the same reasoning applies at every amplification in def-extended-epsilon-cstar-algebra. Hence the exact A_R just certified is an extended epsilon_R-C*-algebra. Also c0*epsilon <= epsilon_R because W.L >= 1 and the supplied inclusion tolerance is nonnegative, and L^0*epsilon <= epsilon_R, so every direct-envelope projection, subordination, and complementarity error is at most epsilon_R.
